steps: Grate the potato and onion finely into the same bowl.
Let the mass stand three minutes and pour off the water that gathers on top, leaving the sediment.
Season with salt and pepper. Add nothing else.
Heat the oil over medium and drop the mixture in by the spoonful, flattening it to half a centimetre.
Fry three to four minutes a side, to a deep golden crisp crust.
Drain on paper and serve immediately with soured cream and dill.
